sections.Profile:
"Fashion Show," released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in 1962, is a two-player electro-mechanical pinball machine designed by Wayne Neyens with artwork by Roy Parker. This machine features two flippers, three pop bumpers, two slingshots, and a rotating center disc that advances scores when hit. The game’s theme revolves around pageantry and fashion, highlighted by its charming backglass artwork.
